spans.s:
अतृणादः [न तृणं अत्ति, अद्-अण्] ‘Not
eating grass’, a newborn calf; अथ
वत्सं जातमाहुरतृणाद इति Bṛ. Ār. Up.

अतृण्या [न. त.] A small
quantity of grass.

अतृदिल a. [न तृद्यते वध्यते,
तृद्किलच्] Ved. Not assailable,
immovable, solid, firm (as a mountain).

अत्तृ a. [अद्-तृच्] One who eats;
अरक्षितारमत्तारं नृपं विद्यादधोगतिं

To pass through or
over.
--2 To cross over.
--3 To
overcome.
--4 To enlarge, increase.

To split, sever,
pierce.
--2 To push open, open.

आतृण्ण p. p. [आ-तृद्-क्त] Pierced,
cut.
--णं
1 An opening, hole.
--2
An open wound.

आतृप् {c4c} {c5c} {c6c} P. To be satisfied.
--Caus. To satisfy.

आतृप्यः A kind of tree, the custard
apple tree.
--प्यं The fruit of the tree.
